description: Shrink JPG, PNG and WebP images right in your browser with an adjustable quality slider. Compare before/after sizes, download each file or grab everything as a ZIP.

faqs.a: Yes — the quality slider only affects JPEG and WebP output. PNG is lossless, so re-encoding a PNG keeps every pixel (the file may still shrink slightly).
faqs.q: Does the quality slider affect PNG files?

faqs.a: Converting to JPEG gives the smallest files but removes transparency — transparent areas are filled white. Choose WebP or PNG if you need to keep transparency.
faqs.q: Why did my transparent PNG turn white?

faqs.a: Your files are processed locally with the canvas API. Nothing is uploaded, and there are no watermarks or limits.
faqs.q: Is there a file size or count limit?

howto: Drop one or more images into the upload zone (JPG, PNG, WebP…).
Set the quality slider (10–95) and pick an output format — keep original, JPEG, WebP or PNG.
Click “Compress images” and compare the original vs compressed size for each file.
Download images individually, or click “Download all as ZIP” for multiple files.
title: Image Compressor
